title: The interlayer proton capture and transport mechanism in oxygen electrodes boosts proton ceramic electrolysis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05802C, Paper
Meijuan Fei, Zhaohui Cai, Peng Chen, Dongliang Liu, Cheng Huang, Jianqiu Zhu, Linjuan Zhang, Wei Wang, Chuan Zhou, Wei Zhou, Zongping Shao
A reversible phase transition in an RP-type oxygen electrode creates proton-trapping sites. This mechanism dramatically enhances steam hydration and enables low-energy interlayer proton transport.
